CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_live_actor_session_v1(p_workspace_id uuid, p_actor_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_roles text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.role()) is distinct from 'service_role'
    or p_workspace_id is null or p_actor_id is null or p_session_id is null
    or p_roles is null or cardinality(p_roles)=0 then
    raise exception 'actor_session_denied' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  perform 1 from auth.sessions as session_row
  join auth.users as account on account.id=session_row.user_id
  join public.workspace_members as member
    on member.user_id=account.id and member.workspace_id=p_workspace_id
  where session_row.id=p_session_id and session_row.user_id=p_actor_id
    and account.deleted_at is null
    and (account.banned_until is null or account.banned_until<=clock_timestamp())
    and (session_row.not_after is null or session_row.not_after>clock_timestamp())
    and member.status='active' and member.role=any(p_roles)
  for share of session_row, account, member;
  if not found then raise exception 'actor_session_denied' using errcode='42501'; end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.google_sheets_privacy_open_v1(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform private.google_sheets_privacy_lock_v1(p_workspace_id);
 if exists(select 1 from private.google_sheets_privacy_epochs where workspace_id=p_workspace_id and blocked) then
  raise exception 'google_sheets_privacy_paused' using errcode='55000';
 end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.google_sheets_ticket_actor_v1(p_workspace_id uuid, p_actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_actor_id is null or (auth.role()<>'service_role' and (auth.role()<>'authenticated' or auth.uid() is distinct from p_actor_id)) then
  raise exception 'google_sheets_read_denied' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from public.workspace_members m join auth.users u on u.id=m.user_id
  where m.workspace_id=p_workspace_id and m.user_id=p_actor_id and m.status='active' and u.deleted_at is null
   and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp())) then
  raise exception 'google_sheets_read_denied' using errcode='42501'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.google_sheets_erasure_cascade_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if nullif(current_setting('vaeroex.google_sheets_erasure_request',true),'') is not null
  and not private.google_sheets_exact_delete_allowed_v1(old.workspace_id,tg_table_name,old.id,to_jsonb(old))
  and not(tg_op='UPDATE' and tg_table_name='file_uploads' and private.google_sheets_exact_delete_allowed_v1(old.workspace_id,'file_upload_analysis',old.id,to_jsonb(old)))
  and not(tg_op='UPDATE' and tg_table_name='vsi_requests' and private.google_sheets_exact_delete_allowed_v1(old.workspace_id,'vsi_request_content',old.id,to_jsonb(old))
   and to_jsonb(new)->>'question_hash'='' and to_jsonb(new)->>'conversation_id' is null
   and (to_jsonb(new)-'question_hash'-'conversation_id')=(to_jsonb(old)-'question_hash'-'conversation_id')) then
  raise exception 'sheets_erasure_unlisted_cascade' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 if tg_op='UPDATE' then return new; end if;
 return old;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.google_sheets_privacy_lock_v1(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('google_sheets:'||p_workspace_id::text,0));
$function$
